findings.claim: Playwright could test an unrelated server and stale @wterm/dom dist.
findings.evidence: The original run reused a process on port 4173; a mutation stayed green until @wterm/dom was rebuilt. The web server now builds the package and disables reuse.

findings.claim: Virtualization narrows browser find and accessibility to mounted rows.
findings.evidence: The DOM contains only the viewport window plus overscan, except an active selected range; documentation now states this scope.

findings.claim: A third-party core without the optional rollover signal could keep stale visible rows at constant history count.
findings.evidence: Force-red left AA visible after history changed to BB; disabling the fast path without the signal made the test pass.

findings.claim: The Ghostty patch verifier did not require reset and rollback transitions.
findings.evidence: The required list checked initialization, clone, increment, and getter but omitted reset and decrement. Both are now required and patch idempotence passed.
